title: Divan Beds
descriptionHtml:
For a divan bed with storage, choose between a divan base with drawers, which suits everyday items, and an ottoman divan bed, whose gas lift base lifts the whole mattress for bulky things. Check that the base takes a standard UK mattress and fits your room. Our divans are handmade to order in Dewsbury: the Divan Storage Base with Drawers from £168.99 and the Ottoman Gas Lift Divan Base from £220.99.

A divan bed is an upholstered base that supports your mattress, usually paired with a matching headboard. Ours are handmade to order in Dewsbury on solid wood frames, with pull-out drawers or gas lift ottoman storage, and delivered free across Great Britain.

Not quite right? For a lifting storage platform see ottoman divan beds; for a complete bed frame with headboard see upholstered beds.

Divan bed buying guide

Which type of divan?

  • Divan with drawers — drawers built into the base for everyday items. See the Divan Storage Base with Drawers and our storage beds with drawers.
  • Ottoman divan — the platform lifts on gas struts for storage under the whole bed. See the Ottoman Gas Lift Divan Base (end lift) and the Side Lift Ottoman Storage Base.
  • Divan bed sets — base and headboard together, such as the Small Line Divan Bed, Brooklyn Divan Bed, Divan Bed with Footboard and Multi Mini Line Divan Ottoman Bed.

Measuring up

Measure the wall the bed will sit against and the floor space around it. Drawers need clear floor in front of them to open; an ottoman lid needs clear height above the bed.

Sizes and fabrics

Made in Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT), upholstered in Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé. See our UK bed sizes guide.

Ottoman divan bed or divan base with drawers?

Both are upholstered divan bases that take a standard UK mattress and pair with a headboard. The difference is how you reach the storage.

Ottoman divan bed Divan base with drawers
How it opens The whole mattress platform lifts on gas struts and stays open Drawers pull out of the base
Storage One large space under the whole bed Separate drawer compartments
Suits Duvets, suitcases, seasonal clothes Clothes and linen you use every day
Space needed Headroom above, plus clear floor at the foot (end lift) or one side (side lift) Clear floor in front of the drawers
From (Single 3ft) £220.99, Ottoman Gas Lift Divan Base £168.99, Divan Storage Base with Drawers

If the foot of your bed sits against a wall, the Side Lift Ottoman Storage Base (from £249.99) opens from the side instead. Want the ottoman divan with a matching headboard? See the Multi Mini Line Divan Ottoman Bed (from £324.99) or browse all ottoman divan beds.

Frequently asked questions

What is an ottoman divan bed?

An ottoman divan bed is a divan base whose top lifts on gas struts, so the space inside the base becomes storage. It sits on the floor like any divan and takes a standard UK mattress.

Can I buy a divan base with drawers on its own?

Yes. The Divan Storage Base with Drawers is sold as a base, from £168.99 in Single to £259.99 in Super King, and pairs with any Eagle Bed headboard.

Do divan beds come with a headboard?

Divan bases can be ordered on their own, or as a set with a matching upholstered headboard — check each product page. You can also choose a separate headboard from our headboards collection.

Divan with drawers or ottoman?

Drawers are easier for things you use every day. An ottoman gives more space for bulky items such as duvets and suitcases, but needs room above the bed to open.

How long does delivery take, and can I return a bed?

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales), made by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Returns are free within 14 days if the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging, and a faulty item is replaced free or fully refunded. See our returns policy.

What warranty do I get?

Every Eagle Bed comes with a 5-year warranty. See our warranty page for the full terms.
